# EXC001: exception-reason-rejected

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| family | EXC |
| product | frob |
| severity (default) | error |
| tier | universal |
| scope | repo |
| fix | manual |
| version | 1 |
| since | 2.0.0 |

An accept or defer directive carries a reason the checker rejects.

The `because` text failed `gob_rules::check_reason`: too short, a banned
phrase, a restated rule id or a repeated word. Name an ADR, a style anchor
or a real one-sentence reason. The exception still suppresses its finding
so the gate fails on this rule alone.

## Examples

### EXC001 rejected exception reasons / Fires on a banned phrase #1 (line 6) (fire)

<!-- frob:waive DOC004 reason="generated example copied from the rule's test corpus" -->
```rust
/* frob:accept COV001 because="temporary workaround until later" */ // error: EXC001
pub fn f() {}
```
